title: Patient Discharge Procedure
content:
SOP: Patient Discharge Procedure (SOP-DIS-001)
DEPARTMENT: Admission and Discharge
VERSION: 2.4
ROLES: discharge, billing, pharmacist, nurse, doctor
PURPOSE: Execute 4-point discharge clearance and safe clinical handover.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Patient Discharge Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Patient Discharge Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Patient Discharge Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Patient Discharge Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Patient Discharge Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of Patient Discharge Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 7: Execute phase 7 of Patient Discharge Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Admission and Discharge.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-DIS-001 Patient Discharge Procedure v2.4, Section 4
